name: Game with a custom networking protocol

mentions.name: Game with a custom networking protocol
mentions.description: A game built around a custom networking protocol, with the protocol design itself as the central focus. The goal is a carefully designed, necessary and sufficient protocol under which many games could be subsumed, with gameplay made fun on top of that foundation.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on making a game with a custom networking protocol, but with a focus on the networking protocol itself.
mentions.author: sigbottle
